records.source: [NPC] Station Master: Thanks for choosing Dwarven Mine Co. - we operate 24/7 across the whole mine!

records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|Now, please climb aboard before your cart leaves without you.|А теперь залезай, пожалуйста, пока вагонетка не уехала без тебя.

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: Again.
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|Again.|Опять.

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: Let's a go!

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: Ever been in one of these before? No?
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|Ever been in one of these before? No?|Раньше ездил в такой? Нет?

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: Well...

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: I'm sure you'll be fine!
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|I'm sure you'll be fine!|Уверен, всё будет хорошо!

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: Quickly now the Minecart is leaving!
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|Quickly now the Minecart is leaving!|Скорее, вагонетка отправляется!

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: Off to the court? I would tell you to talk to the King but I don't know who he is anymore...
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|Off to the court? I would tell you to talk to the King but I don't know who he is anymore...|Едешь ко двору? Посоветовал бы поговорить с королём, но уже не знаю, кто у нас король...

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: Did you know the Court is almost as old as the throne room, it's got some lovely flower beds too!
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|Did you know the Court is almost as old as the throne room, it's got some lovely flower beds too!|Знаешь, двор почти такой же старый, как тронный зал? А ещё там прекрасные клумбы!

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: See those statues? They are the former Kings, Bunumir Ironbeard and Skordous Pebblebeard, guarding the entrance to the mines.
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|See those statues? They are the former Kings, Bunumir Ironbeard and Skordous Pebblebeard, guarding the entrance to the mines.|Видишь статуи? Это прежние короли, Бунумир Железнобородый и Скордоус Камнебородый, охраняющие вход в шахты.

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: Aristocrat passage ey? Best of luck to you.
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|Aristocrat passage ey? Best of luck to you.|Значит, в Проход аристократов? Удачи тебе.

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: Did you know that the Forge is so big it has to have multiple forging stations.
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|Did you know that the Forge is so big it has to have multiple forging stations.|Знаешь, Кузня такая огромная, что в ней пришлось устроить несколько рабочих мест для ковки.

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: You ever seen those Goblins? Some say they lay eggs. How weird.
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|You ever seen those Goblins? Some say they lay eggs. How weird.|Видел здешних гоблинов? Говорят, они откладывают яйца. Вот странность.

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: I once stumbled upon a hidden lake in these parts, Some unsavory characters living there robbed me of all my gold!
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|I once stumbled upon a hidden lake in these parts, Some unsavory characters living there robbed me of all my gold!|Однажды я наткнулся тут на тайное озеро. Живущие там подозрительные типы отняли у меня всё золото!

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: You came down the lift? I never thought you could get this far down! Someone should have called this place the Deeper Caverns!
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|You came down the lift? I never thought you could get this far down! Someone should have called this place the Deeper Caverns!|Ты спустился на лифте? Не думал, что он опускается так глубоко! Надо было назвать это место Ещё более глубокими пещерами!

records.source: [NPC] Station Master: Hey, if you find any Titanium down here let me know! I wanted to buy some of that stuff for a new pickaxe.
records.authored_tsv_row: Station Master|Hey, if you find any Titanium down here let me know! I wanted to buy some of that stuff for a new pickaxe.|Эй, найдёшь тут титан — дай знать! Я хотел прикупить немного для новой кирки.
